meta.label: Import Adaptive Sheet
meta.description: Read rows from a Workday Adaptive Planning sheet (modeled, cube, or standard) into a Dataiku dataset.

params.name: sheet
params.label: Sheet
params.description: Loads dynamically from your Adaptive instance once credentials are set.

params.name: version
params.label: Adaptive version
params.description: Adaptive version name. Leave empty to auto-resolve to the default version.

params.name: cube_section
params.label: Cube sheet filters
params.description: Cube exports require explicit account, level, and time-span filters. The dropdowns below load from your Adaptive instance.

params.name: accounts
params.label: Accounts
params.description: Accounts to include. Descendants are included automatically.

params.name: levels
params.label: Levels
params.description: Levels to include. Descendants are included automatically.

params.name: time_start
params.label: Time start
params.description: Adaptive time period code, e.g. 01/2024 or Jan-24.

params.name: time_end
params.label: Time end
params.description: Adaptive time period code, e.g. 12/2024 or Dec-24.

params.name: dimensions
params.label: Dimensions in output
params.description: Optional. Dimensions to include as columns in the exported rows.
